GOV-F-003-S24.title: Expired Lock Recovery and Orphan Cleanup
GOV-F-003-S24.description: Implement recovery logic to detect expired locks (via TTL or timestamp comparison) and safely reclaim them. Handle orphaned locks where owner processes have terminated without release.

GOV-F-003-S25.title: Brain Runner Enforcement of Lock Ownership
GOV-F-003-S25.description: Integrate lock acquisition, renewal, and release into brain_runner execution flow to ensure only one active process modifies Brain state at a time, enforcing ownership checks before critical operations.

GOV-F-003-S26.title: TTL Expiration and Recovery Test Suite
GOV-F-003-S26.description: Create unit and integration tests covering TTL expiration, lock renewal, conflict handling, and recovery scenarios including orphaned locks and concurrent acquisition attempts.
